meta.title: Setup docker-compose PostgreSQL + skeleton Spring Boot + skeleton Vue

prompt.goal: Khoi tao nen tang chay duoc: (1) docker-compose PostgreSQL 16 + init 8-10 san pham mau, (2) skeleton Spring Boot ket noi DB thanh cong (endpoint health), (3) skeleton Vue 3 + Vite + Tailwind chay duoc. Sau task nay ket noi DB bang DBeaver duoc.
prompt.context: - May da cai Docker, Node 20+, JDK 17, DBeaver. - Tao thu muc goc "ecommerce-demo": backend/ (Spring Boot), frontend/ (Vue), docker-compose.yml va db/init.sql o thu muc goc. - DB: PostgreSQL 16, db "ecommerce_db", user/pass "postgres"/"postgres", port 5432.

scope.inScope: - docker-compose.yml: postgres (5432), volume persist, healthcheck; db/init.sql tao bang products (id, name, price numeric, image_url, category, description) + 8-10 dong mau (gia VND) - backend/: Spring Boot 3.x (Web, Data JPA, PostgreSQL Driver), application.yml dung bien moi truong; GET /api/health tra {"status":"ok","db":"connected"} (verify bang select 1) - frontend/: Vue 3 + Vite + TailwindCSS, App.vue don gian, fetch mau toi /api/health - README.md: day du lenh chay DB / backend / frontend
scope.outOfScope: - KHONG viet Product entity/repository/API products (task02) - KHONG lam trang danh sach san pham hoan chinh (task03) - KHONG lam gio hang, CORS config chi tiet (task04) - KHONG docker hoa backend/frontend

prompt.hardRules: - Khong hard-code password trong code Java; dung bien moi truong + default - init.sql chay tu dong khi compose up sach - Moi lenh chay phai co trong README
prompt.tasks: 1. docker-compose.yml + db/init.sql; chay "docker compose up -d"; verify healthy 2. Tao Spring Boot project (Web, Data JPA, PostgreSQL Driver) 3. HealthController + ket noi DB thuc te 4. Tao Vue + Vite + Tailwind, App.vue don gian 5. Viet README.md 6. Tu test theo testPlan
prompt.acceptanceCriteria: - [ ] docker compose up -d thanh cong, container healthy - [ ] DBeaver ket noi duoc, thay bang products + 8-10 dong - [ ] GET http://localhost:8080/api/health -> {"status":"ok","db":"connected"} - [ ] npm run dev -> trang "E-commerce Demo" khong loi build - [ ] README du 3 lenh chay
prompt.testPlan: 1. docker compose up -d && docker compose ps -> healthy 2. DBeaver: SELECT * FROM products; dem du 8-10 dong 3. curl http://localhost:8080/api/health -> JSON dung 4. npm run dev, mo trinh duyet khong loi console 5. Lam theo README nhu nguoi moi, khong hoi them
prompt.outputRequired: - Cay thu muc + danh sach file da tao/sua - Pass/fail tung muc testPlan - Thong so ket noi DBeaver - Rui ro phat sinh (neu co)
